theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_rb_total_bounded
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ j, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (u j)) → (∀ j, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, u j x ^ 2 ≤ M) → (∀ j, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ (u j) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ M) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ j, ∃ k ∈ S, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, (u j x - u k x) ^ 2 ≤ η
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
